import json
from driver import run

BASE_REPLAY = {"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1],[2]],[[10],[20]]],"slots":2,"window":1,
               "events":[["send",0,0]]}
BASE_AUDIT = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],
              "edges":[[0,"a",0]],"start":0,"fairness":[]}

def R(**kw):   # replay request with overrides/removals
    r = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE_REPLAY)); r.update(kw)
    for k in [k for k,v in kw.items() if v is None]: del r[k]
    return json.dumps(r)

def A(**kw):
    a = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE_AUDIT)); a.update(kw)
    for k in [k for k,v in kw.items() if v is None]: del a[k]
    return json.dumps(a)

cases = []
def case(exp, line, note=""):
    cases.append((exp, line, note))

# ---------------- E_JSON ----------------
case("E_JSON", "not json", "bare word")
case("E_JSON", "[1,2,3", "truncated")
case("E_JSON", "{\"op\":1,\"inputs\":[]}", "op is int (also schema) -- must pick one; json ok")
case("E_JSON", "{\"op\":\"replay\",\"op\":\"audit\",\"inputs\":[[[1]]],\"slots\":1,\"window\":1,\"events\":[]}", "duplicate key")
case("E_JSON", "   ", "whitespace only")
case("E_JSON", "", "empty line")
case("E_JSON", b"\xff\xfe".decode('latin1').encode('latin1'), "invalid utf8") if False else None
cases.append(("E_JSON", b"\xef\xbb\xbf{}"", "utf8 bom"))
case("E_JSON", json.dumps(BASE_REPLAY).replace("\"slots\":1", "\"slots\":NaN"), "NaN token")
case("E_JSON", json.dumps(BASE_REPLAY).replace("\"slots\":1", "\"slots\":Infinity"), "Infinity token")
case("E_JSON", json.dumps(BASE_REPLAY).replace("\"slots\":1", "\"slots\":-Infinity"), "-Infinity token")
case("E_JSON", "{\"op\":\"replay\",\"inputs\":[[[1]]],\"slots\":1e999,\"window\":1,\"events\":[]}", "overflow float")
case("E_JSON", "[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[", "deep nesting")

# ---------------- E_SCHEMA (replay) ----------------
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"extra":1}), "unknown key")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"slots":None}), "missing key")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"op":"replay","inputs":"x"}), "inputs not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", "[1,2,3]", "top level not object")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"op":"Replay"}), "unknown op")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"op":5}), "op wrong type")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[1]],[[2]] ,[[3]]]}), "nonrectangular P")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[1],[2]],[[1]]]}), "nonrectangular R")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[1,2]],[[1]]]}), "nonrectangular D")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[True]]]}), "boolean value")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[1.5]]]}), "float value")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[["1"]]]}), "string value")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[1]],[[2]]],"slots":"2"}), "slots string")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"inputs":[[[1]]],"window":True}), "window bool")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":["send",0,0]}), "event not array")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":[["send",0,0,0]]}), "event wrong arity")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":[["SEN","0"]]}), "bad kind")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":[["send",[0],0]]}), "rank not int")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":[["retry",0,1]]}), "retry arity")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":[["deliver","0"]]}), "deliver pid type")
case("E_SCHEMA", R(**{"events":[[]]}), "empty event")

# ---------------- E_LIMIT (replay) ----------------
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[1]]]*9}), "P=9")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[1]]*129]}), "R=129")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[1]*33]]}), "D=33")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[1000000001]]]}), "value too big")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[-1000000001]]]}), "value too small")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"slots":17}), "slots 17")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**={"slots":1}) if False else ("E_LIMIT", R(**{"slots":0}), "slots 0"))
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"window":0}), "window 0")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**={"slots":2}, **={"window":3}) if False else ("E_LIMIT", R(**{"slots":2,"window":3}), "window>slots"))
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"events":[["send",0,0]]*20001}), "too many events")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**={"inputs":[[[1],[2]]]}, **={"events":[["send",0,2]]}) if False else
     ("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[1],[2]]],"window":2,"events":[["send",0,2]]}), "send q>=R"))
case("E_LIMIT", R(**={"inputs":[[[1],[2]]]}, **={"events":[["send",1,0]]}) if False else
     ("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[[1],[2]]],"events":[["send",5,0]]}), "send rank>=P"))
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"events":[["deliver",200001]]}), "pid too big")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"events":[["deliver",-1]]}), "pid negative")
case("E_LIMIT", R(**":{"window":5}) if False else ("E_LIMIT", R(**{"events":[["retry",9]]}), "retry rank>=P"))
case("E_LIMIT", R(**{"inputs":[[]],"events":[["send",0,0]]}), "send with R=0")

# ---------------- E_SCHEMA (audit/export) ----------------
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[],"x":1}]}), "state extra key")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[]]}]}), "state missing key")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"ranks":[],"seq":0,"sum":[]}]}]}),
     "slot extra/missing keys")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"ranks":[],"sum":[]}]}]}) if False else
     ("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"ranks":[],"seq":0,"sum":[]}]}]}), "dup seq")
     )
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0,0],"seq":0,"sum":[]}]}]}),
     "dup rank in slot")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"edges":[[0,"a",0],[0,"a",0]]}), "dup triple")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"edges"}) if False else
     ("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"edges":[[0,"a",0],[0,"a",0],[0,"b",0]]}), "dup triple (2)"))
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"weak"},{"action":"a","mode":"strong"}]}),
     "dup fairness action")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"sometimes"}]}), "bad mode")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"fairness":[{"action":"0a","mode":"weak"}]}), "name starts with digit")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"fairness":[{"action":"a-b","mode":"weak"}]}), "name bad char")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"fairness":[{"action":"","mode":"weak"}]}), "empty name")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"fairness":[{"action":True,"mode":"weak"}]}), "action not str")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"edges":[[0,"a",0,0]]}), "edge arity")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"edges":[["0","a",0]]}), "edge source type")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"edges":[[0,1,0]]}), "edge action not str")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**{"start":"0"}), "start type")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"states[0].delivered"} if False else {"states":[{"delivered":1,"slots":[]}]}), "delivered not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[0],"slots":[]}]}), "row not list")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[True]],"slots":[]}]}), "delivered bool")
case("E_SCHEMA", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[["x"]],"slots":[]}]}), "delivered str")

# ---------------- E_LIMIT (audit/export) ----------------
case("E_LIMIT", A(**{"states":[]}), "zero states")
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[]]*129],"slots":[]}]}), "row too long")
BIG = 1 << 60
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[BIG+1]],"slots":[]}]}), "value out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[-BIG-1]],"slots":[]}]}), "value out of range low")
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[2]],"slots":[{"ranks":[9],"seq":0,"sum":[2]}]}]}), "rank out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[2]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0],"seq":1,"sum":[2]}]}]}), "slot seq out of range")
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[2]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2,2]}]}]}), "slot sum width")
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[2],[2]],"slots":[],"x":1} if False else {"delivered":[[[2],[2]]],"slots":[{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2]}]}]}), "too many distinct seq? (dup->schema)") if False else None
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(**={"states":[{"delivered":[[[2]]],"slots":
     [{"ranks":[0],"seq":0,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[1],"seq":1,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":2,"sum":[2]},
      {"ranks":[1],"seq":3,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":4,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[1],"seq":5,"sum":[2]},
      {"ranks":[0],"seq":6,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[1],"seq":7,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":8,"sum":[2]},
      {"ranks":[1],"seq":9,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":10,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[1],"seq":11,"sum":[2]},
      {"ranks":[0],"seq":12,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[1],"seq":13,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":14,"sum":[2]},
      {"ranks":[1],"seq":15,"sum":[2]},{"ranks":[0],"seq":16,"sum":[2]}]}]}), "R must be >=17"))
case("E_LIMIT", A(**={"edges":[[0,"a",0]]*17}) if False else None
)
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(**={"start":1}), "start out of range"))
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(**={"start":-1}), "start negative"))
cases.append(("E_LIMIT", A(**={"edges":[[0,"a",0],[0,"a",0]] if False else [[0,"a",0],[0,"b",0],[0,"c",0]]}), "unreachable start ok? no"))
cases = [c for c in cases if c]

bad = 0
for exp, line, note in cases:
    rows, err = run(line if isinstance(line, bytes) else line)
    got = rows[0]
    ok = (got == {"error": exp}) if exp.startswith("E_") else True
    if not ok:
        bad += 1
        print("MISMATCH:", note, "| exp", exp, "| got", json.dumps(got))
print("error cases:", len(cases), "bad:", bad)
PYEOF
python3 errors_test.py 2>&1 | tail -25
